engine.name: BioNetGen
engine.role: generate the finite mass-action network; independent of Q construction

species.D: assembled dimer of two M units

representation.grain: one state is the complete pair of free-monomer and dimer counts; subunit positions, orientations and binding microstates are intentionally unresolved
representation.catalyst: In feedback reactions D is both a catalyst and a retained product molecule; the other D product is newly assembled from two M substrates. D is a distinct molecule from both M substrates.
representation.scope: coarse ideal-mixture mass-action adaptation, not a resolved molecular binding or spatial model

standard_state.equilibrium_measure: pi(M,D) proportional to 1/(M! D!) on each fixed-inventory class
standard_state.detailed_balance: Every reversible channel pair uses forward/reverse coefficients with ratio a_D/a_M^2 = 1. No fuel or external drive is present.

metastable_slow_reversible.interpretation: slow reversible trapping relative to the common observation clock, with the same equilibrium distribution as the base arm

dimer_feedback.feedback_interpretation: catalytic cycle; catalyst D is retained, substrates are two separate M molecules, and a second D is formed or consumed

measurement.primary: conditional entropy of sampled full declared (M,D) configuration histories in bits
measurement.common_clock_anchor: base-arm monomer dissociation coefficient 1.0 in the declared ideal time unit; held fixed across all arms and roots
measurement.same_law_stationary_baseline: For each arm and inventory, compute the stationary distribution of that arm's Q and average conditional history breadth across stationary-root states. Do not add entropy of the initial stationary mixture. This baseline is reported separately and does not replace same-law assembled versus unassembled root contrasts.

audits.detailed_balance: check pairwise stationary flux on every generated edge against pi proportional to 1/(M!D!)
audits.engine_multiplicity: compare BNG-generated reaction coefficients and falling-factorial propensities with hand-enumerated unit-inventory rates; never apply a second symmetry divisor
audits.network: compare generated reachable states and aggregated generator against independent hand enumeration for every arm and inventory
audits.transition: check stochastic rows, semigroup composition and finite history breadth
audits.limits: finite class, state cap 16 per case; no open-endedness or optimizer-ethics inference

scientific_predictions.claim: The feedback arm has an additional reversible assembly route and may alter finite-horizon breadth from matched roots.
scientific_predictions.classification: directional possibility only; no ranking asserted

scientific_predictions.claim: The slow arm retains the base equilibrium distribution but can differ at fixed physical horizons.
Any arm or root ranking may depend on horizon and cadence.
scientific_predictions.classification: report every registered value and ranking flip

seeds.role: engineering endpoint-distribution checks only; no new scientific statistic depends on seed
